summary.description: 2-6 sentences: what the PR does, overall assessment, and the most important risks.

findings.description: Substantive problems, most severe first. Empty if none.

impact.description: 0-10: 0 = matters only for something like a cosmic-ray bit flip, 10 = the app would not work at all.

trigger.description: What has to happen for the problem to occur.

file.description: Repository-relative path, or empty if not file-specific.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file, or 0 if not applicable.

detail.description: Why it is a problem, with the concrete failure scenario.

suggestion.description: How to fix it, or empty.

edits.description: The exact change, as replacements of line ranges in the PR's version of each file. Empty only if it can't be written as edits.

start_line.description: First line replaced, in the PR's version of the file.

current.description: The exact text of those lines as they are now, copied from the file: every line, with its indentation.

replacement.description: The complete new text of those lines; empty deletes them.

readability.description: Whether the proposed edits make the code better, the same or worse to read.

test_gaps.description: Behaviour introduced or changed by the PR that no test covers.

questions.description: Things the author should clarify; not defects.
